description: Angular component for entity debug settings panel in Thingsboard UI, managing debug configurations and controls.

classes.name: EntityDebugSettingsPanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing entity debug settings, including toggles and duration controls.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component state, sets up controls and fetches configuration based on entity type.

methods.name: onCancel
methods.description: Hides the popover without applying changes.

methods.name: onApply
methods.description: Emits the current debug settings when user applies changes.

methods.name: onReset
methods.description: Resets debug controls to default state.

methods.name: getByEntityTypeDebugLimit
methods.description: Retrieves debug limit configuration string based on entity type.
